issues.jp_before: (8 items) …{をおいて|wooite}他[ほか]{に|ni-location}ない／いない／いません (also ほか{に|ni-location})
issues.problem: ほかに here is the lexicalised adverb 'besides/else', not に marking a location; tagging it ni-location teaches a false function.
issues.action: Removed the slot markup, leaving plain 他[ほか]に / ほかに; focus indices unaffected (slot came after the focus).

issues.jp_before: この大役[たいやく]{を|o-object}任[まか]せられる{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}、彼[かれ]{をおいて|wooite}誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}いない。
issues.problem: Nをおいて誰もいない is less standard than the set frame Nをおいて他に誰もいない.
issues.action: Inserted 他[ほか]に before 誰も.

issues.jp_before: この仕事[しごと]{を|o-object}頼[たの]める{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}、あなた{をおいて|wooite}誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}いません。
issues.problem: Same as above: missing 他に in the set frame.
issues.action: Inserted 他[ほか]に before 誰も.

issues.jp_before: 今年[ことし]{の|no-possessive}優勝[ゆうしょう]{は|wa-topic}、あのチーム{をおいて|wooite}考[かんが]えられない。
issues.problem: English 'This year's title is unthinkable for anyone but that team' is unnatural.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'I can't imagine anyone but that team winning the title this year.'

issues.jp_before: この難局[なんきょく]{を|o-object}乗[の]り切[き]れる{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}、経験[けいけん]豊富[ほうふ]な彼[かれ]{をおいて|wooite}いない。
issues.problem: English 'the highly experienced him' is ungrammatical.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'No one but him, with all his experience, can get us through this crisis.'

issues.jp_before: (all 20 items) X{はおろか|waoroka}、Y{さえ/すら/も}…ない
issues.problem: どころか is equally natural with the same meaning in every sentence (XどころかYさえ…ない) but was not listed as an alternative.
issues.action: Focus slot changed to {はおろか/どころか|waoroka} in all 20 items.

issues.jp_before: この山道[やまみち]{は|wa-topic}、車[くるま]{はおろか|waoroka}自転車[じてんしゃ]{も|mo-also}通[とお]れない。
issues.problem: English added 'too narrow', which the Japanese does not say.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'Not even a bicycle can get along this mountain path, let alone a car.'

issues.jp_before: 一流[いちりゅう]{の|no-possessive}ホテル{ともなると/ともなれば|tomonaruto}、客室[きゃくしつ]{の|no-possessive}掃除[そうじ]{も|mo-also}完璧[かんぺき]だ。
issues.problem: English 'Once you get to a first-class hotel' misreads it as arriving somewhere.
issues.action: English changed to 'When it comes to a first-class hotel, …'.

issues.jp_before: 海外旅行[かいがいりょこう]{ともなると/ともなれば|tomonaruto}、準備[じゅんび]{も|mo-also}大変[たいへん]だ。
issues.problem: English 'Once it is a trip abroad' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'When it comes to a trip abroad, …'.

issues.jp_before: 老舗[しにせ]{の|no-possessive}旅館[りょかん]{ともなれば/ともなると|tomonaruto}、女将[おかみ]{の|no-possessive}もてなし{も|mo-also}格別[かくべつ]だ。
issues.problem: English 'Once it is a long-established inn' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'When it comes to a long-established inn, the proprietress's hospitality is exceptional too.'

issues.jp_before: 桜[さくら]{の|no-possessive}満開[まんかい]{とあって|toatte}、川沿[かわぞ]い{の|no-possessive}道[みち]{は|wa-topic}花見客[はなみきゃく]{で|de-cause}歩[ある]きにくかった。
issues.problem: English 'hard to walk on for the crowds' is awkward and obscures the blossom viewers.
issues.action: English rewritten: '…the riverside path was so crowded with blossom viewers that it was hard to walk along.'

issues.jp_before: 創立[そうりつ]百周年[ひゃくしゅうねん]{とあって|toatte}、今年[ことし]{の|no-possessive}式典[しきてん]{は|wa-topic}例年[れいねん]{より|yori-comparison}ずっと盛大[せいだい]だった。
issues.problem: English adds 'the school's', which the Japanese does not specify.
issues.action: English changed to 'the hundredth anniversary of the founding'.
